subject.title: fix(ollama): preserve custom memory provider endpoints

question: After narrowing the shared sanitizer, should this PR intentionally invalidate existing Ollama memory indexes once so endpoint changes receive distinct persisted identities?
rationale: The branch proves the normal rebuild path works, but accepting an upgrade-triggered rebuild for every existing Ollama index is an operator-impact choice requiring maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept one-time rebuild
options.body: Land the endpoint-aware identity after the sanitizer repair and record that existing Ollama indexes rebuild once through the normal path.

options.title: Design compatibility migration
options.body: Pause the PR and design a narrower migration that preserves old identities only where endpoint equivalence can be proven without retaining collisions.

recommendation.title: Accept one-time rebuild
recommendation.body: Land the endpoint-aware identity after the sanitizer repair and record that existing Ollama indexes rebuild once through the normal path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced the relevant Ollama memory adapter and endpoint-aware cache-identity behavior.
